decisions.reason: The firm has made heavy, visible investment in this product, backed by government references to the UK Home Office and over 30 APIS schemes, so it remains central to its aviation data direction and management will persist with it.

Post-pandemic demand keeps fading, but the dedicated page and its fit with the travel data offer let management still blame weak uptake on temporary market conditions and justify the earlier investment.
The module is cheap to maintain alongside the certified training business, so although commitment is limited to a passing mention, there is little pressure to withdraw it.
Behaviour analysis is core to the firm's specialist detection identity and announced innovation direction, so management continues to persist with it despite low visibility.
The profiling method rests on long-standing aviation security expertise and sunk development effort, which management uses to justify keeping it.
